conditions: Parts never drop from the bounty reward itself, only from Albrecht's Laboratories endless mission rotations.
You get one bounty reward regardless of how long you stay past the objective.
bonuses: It shares the table with Qorvex Neuroptics, Shrill Voca, Aya, credits and Endo, so a spare blueprint is common if you're also farming Qorvex.
The blueprint is tradable, so spares from repeated runs are easy to offload or acquire.
